## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Fear easing: VXX (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND and Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT (SPY 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND point mildly risk-on while credit stress HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -0.51% | 1M: +0.17% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.12% BELOW TREND) and XLY_XLP contraction keep the picture balanced.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD showing strain (HYG 1W: -0.51% | 1M: +0.17% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.12% BELOW TREND). Fear easing and stock leadership are offset by reflation via energy: VXX (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-mixed: Dollar recovering (Dollar Strength 1W: +1.96% | 1M: -0.44% ↑ RECOVERY) while TLT (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -0.70%) BELOW TREND shows higher yields pressure even as SPY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND keeps equities supported.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Rotation-leaning: XLE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -1.35%) RECOVERY showing relative strength while XLK (1W: -0.56% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION. Style mixed / no clear leadership given 6/11 breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND while EM/Emerging ETFs show catch-up with EEM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Cooling: IWM (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +6.51%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -10.94% | 1M: -10.94%) BELOW TREND show speculative flows retrenching.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation signals mixed: CPER (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +2.63%) CORRECTION and metals (GLD 1W: -8.08% | 1M: +7.78% CORRECTION) volatile, while energy (XLE 1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94% ABOVE TREND; BNO 1W: +2.32% | 1M: +10.45% ABOVE TREND) is the clearest reflation driver.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +10.45%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -14.36% | 1M: +3.59%) CORRECTION remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND across timeframes. DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: -0.56% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION and GLD (1W: -8.08% | 1M: +7.78%) CORRECTION highlight cross-asset mismatches to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/reflection plays and quality income exposure while reducing exposure to speculative thematic/crypto ETFs; XLE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +17.11%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, ARKK (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -10.94% | 1M: -10.94%) BELOW TREND showing weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +17.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.56% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +10.45%) ABOVE TREND and energy complex. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -14.36% | 1M: +3.59%) CORRECTION and gold SLV/GLD (GLD 1W: -8.08% | 1M: +7.78% CORRECTION; SLV 1W: -26.34% | 1M: +12.45% CORRECTION) remain under pressure.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 26.12 (VXX 1W: -1.69% | 1M: -1.32%) — complacency watch; HYG/LQD ratio 0.7339 (Credit Stress ↑) — stress threshold; SPY/TLT 8.03 (SPY 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND — equities vs bonds tilt; XLK/XLF 2.6885 (XLK 1W: -0.56% | 1M: +0.90%; XLF 1W: +1.16% | 1M: -1.35%) — rotation metric.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. XLE and SOXX showing relative strength while tech and gold display correction-style divergences; monitor HYG/LQD credit stress and XLK/XLF rotation as the key risks.
